# Frantz Augustin

> Personal website of Frantz Augustin, an independent researcher and multidisciplinary creative based in San Diego. His work explores artificial intelligence, cognitive science, and human computer interaction — specifically how machines learn, how humans make meaning, and how the two might meet in ways that feel generous.

Frantz's philosophy: technology should help humans, not replace them. His independent research focuses on perception, meaning, and the interaction between humans and intelligent systems.

He also runs Frantz Studio (AI native consultancy), Chez Frantz (online store for stationery and creative goods), and Frantz Photography (fashion and documentary practice).

## Research & Writing

- [Research & Writing](https://frantzaugustin.com/writing/): Research interests and curated micro-essays on cognition and intelligent systems
- [Move 37](https://frantzaugustin.com/writing/move-37/): A poem reflecting on AlphaGo's move 37, exploring unity, perfection, and the intersection of AI and meaning
